items.source: Note: implementing this contract is not required but it should be implemented when the handler needs to be prioritized ahead of others. For example custom (async) handlers, by default ordered after built-in handlers, should take precedence over @ResponseBody or @ModelAttribute handling, which should occur once the async value is ready. By contrast, built-in (async) handlers are already ordered ahead of sync handlers.
items.translation: 注意： 实现此合约并非必需，但在需要将该处理器优先于其他处理器执行时，应予以实现。例如，自定义（异步）处理器默认位于内置处理器之后，因此应优先于 `@ResponseBody` 或 `@ModelAttribute` 处理；后者应在异步值准备好后执行。相比之下，内置（异步）处理器已默认排在同步处理器之前。

items.source: Whether the given return value represents asynchronous computation.
items.translation: 给定返回值是否表示异步计算。

items.source: returnValue - the value returned from the handler method
items.translation: returnValue - 从处理程序方法返回的值

items.source: true if the return value type represents an async value
items.translation: true 如果返回值类型表示异步值。
